per_candidate.id: s2:RAMBO. I. Project Introduction and First Results with uGMRT

rationale: The papers [2309.06625, 2023-09-12] and [2408.11242, 2024-08-20] investigate coherent radio emissions from hot magnetic stars, contributing evidence relevant to the characterization of their magnetospheres. Additionally, [2605.23768, 2026-05-22] surveys radio emissions from magnetic massive stars, which may inform models of stellar magnetic activity.
